title: i do not recommend this product
text: i do not recommend this product. My daughter gave me a blood orange sor candle a few months back. the scent from the candle filled the room with a fresh orange scent that was not overwhelming, it was a light clean fresh scent. I have been look for a candle like the one she gave me ever since. I came across th his candle and decided to try it in hopes that it would do the same. this is not it. you can barely smell any scent at all. it is an average size candle that comes pleasantly wrapped in a soft sheer fabric. when lit it's pleasing to the eye as most candles are, but there is literally no scent coming from the candle. with this in mind, the candle is overpriced and not worth the money. you can get the same affect with a dollar store candle. I do not recommend.

product_metadata.title: 80 Acres Blood Orange Soy Candle - 6.5 oz
